content.text: # Pre-launch audit: Bäckerei Sonnenblume ## Established defects 1. **`robots.txt` blocks the whole site from crawlers.** - Evidence: `User-agent: *` followed by `Disallow: /`. - This is a launch blocker. Search engines are told not to crawl any page, which contradicts the `sitemap.xml` that lists four URLs. 2. **The home page is set to `noindex, nofollow`.** - File: `index.html` - Evidence: `` - This looks like a leftover from staging. The most important page would be kept out of search results, and its links would not be followed. 3. **`kontakt.html` and `sortiment.html` have no ``.** - Evidence: both `<head>` sections contain only charset, viewport and canonical. - Browser tabs, bookmarks and search snippets will show no meaningful page title. 4. **`kontakt.html` and `sortiment.html` have no meta description.** - Evidence: neither file has `<meta name="description">`, while `index.html` and `impressum.html` do. - The Kontakt page matters most for a local business. 5. **All three images lack `alt` attributes.** - `index.html`: `<img src="/laden.jpg" />` - `sortiment.html`: `<img src="/brot.jpg" />` and `<img src="/kuchen.jpg" />` - This is an accessibility failure. On `sortiment.html` the images are the only content besides the heading, so screen-reader users and search engines get nothing about the product range. 6. **There is no site navigation, and `kontakt.html` and `impressum.html` are not linked from any page.** - Evidence: the only `<a>` in the whole site is `index.html` → `/sortiment.html`. - `kontakt.html` and `impressum.html` are orphans. Visitors cannot reach the address page, and the legally required Impressum is not reachable from any page. - `sortiment.html`, `kontakt.html` and `impressum.html` have no link back to the home page or to each other. 7. **The Impressum is incomplete for a German business site.** - File: `impressum.html` - Evidence: the body is only `<h1>Impressum</h1><p>Inhaberin: Anna Sonnenblume</p>`. - It has no postal address and no electronic contact (email or phone). The address appears only on the Kontakt page. German law (§5 DDG) requires these details in the legal notice. - The page is also very thin, with no business name or legal form. 8. **`kontakt.html` has no way to contact the business.** - Evidence: the only content is `Salzstraße 12, 79098 Freiburg`. - There is no phone number, email, or opening hours. The hours appear only on the home page. For a local business, this is a functional gap on the page meant to serve that purpose. ## Uncertainties (not established from the supplied files) - **Image files may be missing.** `/laden.jpg`, `/brot.jpg` and `/kuchen.jpg` are referenced but not supplied. They may exist on the server and simply not be part of this text-file evidence. Confirm before launch. - **Canonical and sitemap URLs may not match the real paths.** - The canonicals and `sitemap.xml` use extensionless URLs (`/sortiment`, `/kontakt`, `/impressum`). - The files are `.html`, and the home page links to `/sortiment.html`. - If the server does not rewrite or redirect between these forms, the canonicals and sitemap entries would point to 404s, and `/sortiment.html` would be a duplicate of the canonical URL. This depends on server configuration that was not supplied. - **No favicon was supplied.** It is not referenced in any `<head>`, and `/favicon.ico` is absent from the files. This is cosmetic, and the file may exist at the server root. - **`robots.txt` has no `Sitemap:` directive.** This is optional, and moot until item 1 is fixed.
